description: IDH dirty-reset guard wiring (ticket 0809, reviewed by two third-party seats 2026-09-28). The same canonical script as the Claude Code PreToolUse wiring in the adapter plugin (claude-code/hooks/hooks.json — the single Claude hook source since 0887): Codex's PreToolUse payload carries tool_input.command and its block contract accepts exit 2 with the reason on stderr, so the guard runs unchanged. The installed hook launcher resolves the checkout from its own real location. Scope: the PreToolUse entry wires the ONE dirty-reset guard; it is not a general Git-mutation boundary. A SessionStart entry (ticket 1122) also runs scripts/on-start-context.sh, whose stdout reaches the model as context (measured on Codex 0.163.0). Install: run <checkout>/bin/idh install to merge this hook into ~/.codex/hooks.json, verify the guard script exists and answers exit 2 on a fixture (docs/adapter-operations.md), then review and trust it once via /hooks (headless one-offs: --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust). Codex hook trust authenticates the hook definition, not the script it invokes; the script's integrity is the harness checkout's business.

hooks.command: [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/idh-hook" ] || { echo "IDH: hook launcher missing; run <checkout>/bin/idh install from a plain terminal" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$HOME/.local/bin/idh-hook" on-start-context.sh
